annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and finite-sum formalization of the residual-image half of Lemma 4.2

assumptions: A*Ainv acts as the identity on the selected residual q.
The update error obeys the paper's componentwise relative bound with nonnegative u.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P08 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P08 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p08_t2_lemma_4_2_residual_bound {n : Nat} (A Ainv : Fin n -> Fin n -> Real) ... : forall i, abs (p08MatVec A (xNext-x) i) <= abs (q i) + u*p08AbsProductAction A Ainv q i + u*p08AbsAction A x i
formal_statement.plain_language: The rounded refined iterate satisfies the componentwise residual-image bound in the first conclusion of Lemma 4.2.

informal_proof: Rewrite xNext-x as Ainv*q+h, distribute A over the two terms, substitute A*(Ainv*q)=q, bound A*h componentwise, and use the update-rounding hypothesis plus the absolute action bound for Ainv*q.
informal_statement: The residual-image conclusion of Lemma 4.2, with the product of absolute matrices expanded as finite sums.
paper_version: published journal version; volume 35, issue 151, July 1980, printed pages 817-832

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: The baseline separately supplies absolute-action control and matrix-vector additivity, but no declaration packages both of Skeel's simultaneous bounds.

source_locations.anchor: Lemma 4.2, first displayed inequality and its proof

tier_rationale: The L proof combines NumStability.abs_matMulVec_le and NumStability.matMulVec_add_right from NumStability/Analysis/MatrixAlgebra.lean with the inverse-action equation and componentwise update rounding; no single frozen declaration gives Skeel's expanded residual-image bound.
